summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20444 (KIP-1319) by adding support for GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND and STALE_MEMBER_EPOCH error handling in TxnOffsetCommitHandler. These errors are now treated as group metadata mismatch errors (creating CommitFailedException with abortable state) matching the behavior of ILLEGAL_GENERATION and UNKNOWN_MEMBER_ID. All 166 TransactionManagerTest tests pass, including the two previously failing parameterized tests for these new error types.
